bid.title: SIEM and SOAR Software
bid.buyer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology / Department of Electronics and Information Technology
bid.reason: The tender is explicitly for SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) and SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation and Response) software for cyber incident response, not for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) financial crime detection.

evidence.quote: Item Category / वस्तु श्रेणी / SIEM and SOAR Software (Q2)
CERT-In has been set up to enhance the Cyber Security of the Country. It mainly serves as a central point for responding to Cyber Security Incidents as and when they occur

Detection – Behaviour-based detection, Detection of zero-day, insider threats, and lateral movement Analytics Engine – Advanced analytics with rule-based correlation and machine learning-based anomaly detection

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply of SIEM and SOAR software and hardware for CERT-In's cyber security incident response operations.
